mechanism: Amphotericin B causes electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) and renal impairment, which increase dronedarone's QT-prolongation risk and arrhythmogenic potential.
action: Monitor electrolytes (K+, Mg2+) and renal function closely; correct electrolyte abnormalities promptly; consider ECG monitoring; use alternative antifungal if possible.
